development.en: We're about to open a ticket-booking site and want each merge to roll out to our AWS account on Fargate with health checks and an easy rollback, without anyone babysitting the release. The Postgres 16 cluster behind it already shows slow checkout queries, so we need to see which statements hurt and get index suggestions before launch. Password-reset and receipt messages also need to go out exactly once, even when our API retries a request.
development.zh: 我们准备上线一个演出票务网站，希望每次合并都能自动发布到 AWS 的 Fargate 上，带健康检查，出问题能一键回滚，不用有人盯着。背后的 Postgres 16 已经出现结账查询变慢的情况，上线前得看清哪些语句最拖后腿并拿到索引建议。密码重置和收据邮件在接口重试时也不能重复发送。

development.en: A subscription-billing portal is moving to Azure Container Apps, and releases need to promote through staging with sign-in handled by our existing Entra tenant. Its MySQL 8 database shows buffer-pool pressure during month-end runs, and we keep getting asked why some invoices fail silently; the answer should come from the Application Insights events already flowing into Azure Monitor.
development.zh: 一个订阅计费门户正在迁到 Azure Container Apps，发布要能按环境逐步推进，登录沿用现有的 Entra 租户。它的 MySQL 8 在月末跑批时缓冲池压力很大，而且总有人问为什么有些发票悄悄失败了；答案应该能从已经进入 Azure Monitor 的 Application Insights 事件里找到。

development.en: Our loyalty programme is growing fast: the phone app shares one JavaScript codebase across the App Store and Google Play, the backend runs on Cloud Run, and order events already stream through Kafka, where each member's points must stay in order and never be counted twice. Transaction history lives in SQL Server 2022 with Always On, and we also want segmented campaigns with A/B tests to bring people back.
development.zh: 我们的会员积分项目增长很快：手机端用一套 JavaScript 代码同时发布到 App Store 和 Google Play，后端跑在 Cloud Run 上，订单事件已经走 Kafka，同一个会员的积分必须保持顺序且不能重复计算。交易记录放在启用了 Always On 的 SQL Server 2022 里，另外还想做分群活动和 A/B 测试，把顾客重新拉回来。

development.en: A regional health service is putting its appointment system into a Kubernetes cluster we run ourselves in a Frankfurt data centre, with images pulled from our internal registry and no traffic leaving the building. Logs from the cluster and from services that authenticate against LDAP need to be searchable on the same network, and patient notifications must be handled by a mail provider whose storage and logs stay inside the EU.
development.zh: 一个地区医疗服务要把预约系统放进我们自己在法兰克福机房维护的 Kubernetes 集群，镜像只从内部仓库拉取，流量不出机房。集群和走 LDAP 登录的各服务产生的日志要能在同一内网里检索，发给病人的通知则必须由存储和日志都留在欧盟境内的邮件服务商处理。

development.en: Field inspectors use an iPhone app to photograph handwritten inspection forms, and we need signed builds going to registered test devices whenever the code changes. Inspectors also pay a small report fee by card or Apple Pay, and Postgres holds both job history and payment references. The photographed forms are often skewed or written in several languages, so they must come back as searchable text without retyping.
development.zh: 外勤检查员用 iPhone 拍下手写的检查表，我们希望代码一改就能生成签名包，装到已登记的测试机上。检查员还会通过银行卡或 Apple Pay 支付一笔报告费，Postgres 里同时存着工单历史和支付流水。拍下来的表格经常歪斜，语言也不统一，需要变成可搜索的文字，不能靠人工重打。

development.en: A group of neighbourhood restaurants is replacing its till software: staff will use a Flutter app on counter tablets, customers will order from the same catalogue on the web, and one payout schedule will cover both. Orders land in MongoDB 6 replica sets, while reporting needs those changes streamed continuously instead of polling the primary every few minutes. Everything is hosted on Azure, so failures should be traceable from Application Insights.
development.zh: 几家社区餐厅正在更换收银系统：店员在柜台平板上用 Flutter 应用，顾客也能在网上从同一份商品目录下单，线上线下共用一套结算周期。订单写进 MongoDB 6 副本集，报表那边希望持续接收变更，而不是每隔几分钟去主库轮询。系统都放在 Azure 上，出错时要能从 Application Insights 追到原因。

development.en: A grocery delivery startup in Amsterdam ships an Android app whose customers pay with iDEAL and SEPA direct debit, with payouts and disputes visible in one place. Every night the order and basket tables have to be loaded into the warehouse through a chain of SQL and Python steps, with retries and a clear alert when an upstream job is late.
development.zh: 阿姆斯特丹一家生鲜配送初创公司要发布 Android 应用，顾客用 iDEAL 和 SEPA 直接借记付款，退款和拒付也能在一个后台里看清楚。每天夜里还要把订单和购物车表通过一串 SQL 和 Python 步骤装进数据仓库，失败要能重试，上游任务晚了要有人收到提醒。

development.en: We produce white-label fitness apps in Dart for several boutique gym brands, each with its own colours and content, and testers expect the same flow to work on both iPhone and Android. Members pay through their PayPal wallet, and Postgres stores memberships and class credits. The apps talk to a backend on AWS, and when a class booking fails we need to jump straight into the CloudWatch stream for that request.
development.zh: 我们用 Dart 给几个精品健身房品牌做贴牌应用，每个品牌有自己的配色和内容，测试人员希望同一套流程在 iPhone 和 Android 上都正常。会员用 PayPal 钱包付款，Postgres 里存着会籍和课程次数。应用连的是 AWS 上的后端，课程预约失败时要能直接跳到那次请求对应的 CloudWatch 日志里。

development.en: A law practice is digitising decades of client files: scanned bundles arrive from partner firms as CSV manifests and Parquet exports dropped on SFTP, and anything malformed must be quarantined before it reaches the archive. The archive itself has to be PDF/A-3 with embedded fonts and proper metadata for court use. The whole pipeline runs in our own Kubernetes cluster and Elasticsearch, with no log content sent to a vendor cloud, and notification mail must stay within EU data centres.
development.zh: 一家律师事务所正在把几十年的客户档案数字化：合作律所会通过 SFTP 送来 CSV 清单和 Parquet 导出，格式不对的行必须先隔离，不能直接进档案库。归档文件要是 PDF/A-3，嵌入字体，元数据也得符合法院使用的要求。整条流程跑在我们自己的 Kubernetes 集群和 Elasticsearch 上，日志内容不能送到境外云，通知邮件也只能走欧盟境内的数据中心。

development.en: An online furniture shop runs MySQL 8 and has started seeing replication lag whenever the nightly catalogue rebuild runs. That rebuild is a long chain of SQL and Python jobs that loads the warehouse, and when one step fails nobody can tell the next morning which run produced the bad table. The shop's services log to Google Cloud, and old supplier price lists arrive as PDFs that we want to edit in Excel.
development.zh: 一家线上家具店用 MySQL 8，最近每次夜间重建商品目录时都会出现复制延迟。这个重建是一长串 SQL 和 Python 任务，负责往仓库灌数据，一旦某一步失败，第二天早上没人说得清是哪次运行产出了有问题的表。店铺的服务日志在 Google Cloud 上，供应商的旧价格表是 PDF，我们希望直接改成 Excel 来编辑。

development.en: A pizza chain wants one system for counter terminals, online orders and invoices, with a single product list and payout schedule. Orders land in MongoDB 6 replica sets, and the kitchen display already publishes events through Kafka that downstream services consume with per-key ordering. Receipts must be sent exactly once even when the order service retries, and the weekly stack of scanned supplier invoices needs OCR that can cope with handwriting and several languages.
development.zh: 一家披萨连锁店想把柜台终端、网上订单和发票放在一个系统里，商品目录和结算周期都只维护一份。订单写进 MongoDB 6 副本集，后厨显示屏已经把事件发到 Kafka，下游服务需要按 key 保持顺序消费。订单服务重试时，小票邮件也只能发一次；每周收上来的一摞扫描供应商发票还要做 OCR，能认手写和多种语言。

development.en: A professional association is rebuilding its membership portal on Azure Container Apps, with sign-in through Entra ID and release slots that can be swapped back if a health check fails. New members pay for subscriptions by card or Apple Pay, and signed agreements must be kept as PDF/A-2b for the statutory retention period. The association still runs its own mail relay and wants all outgoing messages to leave through that server rather than a third-party sender.
development.zh: 一家行业协会正在 Azure Container Apps 上重做会员门户，登录走 Entra ID，发布槽位在健康检查失败时要能换回去。新会员用银行卡或 Apple Pay 订阅付费，签好的协议要按法定期限保存为 PDF/A-2b。协会还有自己的邮件中继，所有外发邮件都得从这台服务器出去，不能交给第三方代发。

development.en: A ticket resale business runs its API on ECS with Fargate and wants audited, repeatable releases into AWS. Its SQL Server 2022 estate is getting slower around big events and the execution-plan cache is full of one-off queries. Customers across Europe and Asia pay with iDEAL, Bancontact or Alipay, and settlement reports arrive as PDFs that need to become editable Excel files. When a payment callback fails, we need to find it quickly in CloudWatch and VPC flow logs.
development.zh: 一家票务转售公司的 API 跑在 ECS Fargate 上，希望每次发布都可重复、可审计地进入 AWS。它的 SQL Server 2022 在大活动前后变慢，执行计划缓存里塞满了只跑一次的查询。欧洲和亚洲的顾客会用 iDEAL、Bancontact 或支付宝付款，结算报告是 PDF，需要转成可编辑的 Excel。支付回调失败时，要能马上在 CloudWatch 和 VPC 流日志里找到原因。

development.en: An independent publisher is putting its audiobook and ebook catalogue behind a service on Cloud Run, and the iPhone reading app needs TestFlight builds with certificates handled for us after every commit. Manuscripts come in as Word files and must be packaged as EPUB 3 and MOBI with working footnotes and a clickable contents page. The publisher insists that notification mail leave through its own mail server, not an external bulk sender.
development.zh: 一家独立出版社把有声书和电子书目录放到 Cloud Run 上的服务后面，iPhone 阅读应用需要每次提交后自动生成 TestFlight 包，证书也由平台代管。稿件是 Word 文件，要打包成 EPUB 3 和 MOBI，脚注和可点击目录都得正常。出版社坚持通知邮件从自己的邮件服务器发出，不用外部群发平台。

development.en: A wildlife charity runs donation apps built with React Native for several regional campaigns, and each campaign needs its own store listing and colours while sharing the same JavaScript code. Donors check out with a PayPal account, and monthly export files from partner organisations arrive as CSV or Parquet in cloud buckets, where bad rows must be held back before they reach the reporting tables. The backend sits on Google Cloud, and we want its audit entries searchable without writing query syntax.
development.zh: 一家野生动物慈善机构用 React Native 做募捐应用，服务多个地区活动，每个活动都要有自己的商店页面和配色，但共用同一套 JavaScript 代码。捐款人用 PayPal 账户结账，合作机构每月把 CSV 或 Parquet 文件放到云存储桶里，坏行要在进入报表之前被拦住。后端在 Google Cloud 上，我们希望不用学查询语法就能搜索审计记录。

development.en: A niche magazine is launching an Android reading app and wants internal test tracks updated automatically whenever a pull request merges. Back issues are being converted from Word into EPUB 3 and MOBI, keeping the original images and tables of contents. Subscription changes are written to the operational database and must flow into the customer profile store continuously without hammering the primary, and the magazine also wants scheduled newsletter sends with audience segments and simple A/B subject tests.
development.zh: 一本小众杂志要推出 Android 阅读应用，希望每次合并拉取请求就自动更新内部测试轨道。过刊正在从 Word 转成 EPUB 3 和 MOBI，图片和目录都要保留。订阅变更写进业务数据库后，要持续同步到客户资料库，不能一直压主库；杂志还想按受众分群定时发通讯，并做简单的标题 A/B 测试。

holdout.en: We supply software to German municipalities and every invoice has to leave as a structured XML file their systems can ingest, carrying the routing code they assign and the correct VAT treatment; the services themselves run on the Kubernetes cluster we already have Helm charts for, and the Postgres database behind the billing history must be recoverable to any minute within the last thirty days.
holdout.zh: 我们给德国的市政机构供货，每张发票都得是对方系统能直接接收的结构化 XML，还要带上他们分配的流转编码并正确计税；服务本身跑在现有的 Kubernetes 集群上，Helm chart 早就写好了，账单历史所在的 Postgres 则需要能恢复到最近三十天里的任意一分钟。

holdout.en: Invoices to Italian clients have to travel through the national exchange in FatturaPA, and because we operate under banking-style rules everything, including builds, must stay on machines in our own data centre rather than hosted runners; sign-in is a self-hosted identity server we theme ourselves so there are no per-seat charges.
holdout.zh: 开给意大利客户的发票必须以 FatturaPA 经国家交换系统提交；由于我们受类似银行业的合规约束，连构建都只能跑在自己机房的机器上，不能用托管服务；登录则用一套我们自己部署、自己换主题的身份系统，省掉按人头收费。

holdout.en: We are launching in Mexico and need invoices stamped through an authorised certification provider, validating each buyer's RFC and getting IVA and IEPS right; the storefront is containerised and should run on Fargate so the bill lands on the AWS account we already have, with customer login handled by user pools instead of another vendor.
holdout.zh: 我们要在墨西哥开展业务，发票得通过授权的认证服务商盖章，校验买家的 RFC，并把 IVA 和 IEPS 算准；商城是容器化的，希望跑在 Fargate 上、费用直接走现有 AWS 账号，顾客登录就用用户池，不再另找供应商。

holdout.en: Legal insists we stay on Apache-licensed search, so the product catalogue needs its dashboard plugins and the query syntax we have been writing for years, minus the licensing worry; the people answering customer mail live in Zendesk with our views and macros, and we want a Slack bot that can look up an order and answer inside a thread when someone asks in a channel.
holdout.zh: 法务要求搜索必须留在 Apache 许可的组件上，所以商品目录要用它自带的仪表盘插件，我们写了多年的查询语法也得照常能用，省掉授权方面的顾虑；答复客户邮件的同事在 Zendesk 里用着现成的视图和宏，我们还想做个 Slack 机器人，有人在频道里问订单时能在同一串消息里查出来回话。

holdout.en: Our field crews mostly communicate over Telegram, so we want a bot there with inline buttons for shift handovers; site search has to feel instant in São Paulo and Singapore without us running any servers, and staff sign-in already lives in Okta with SAML apps and group-based rules that must keep working.
holdout.zh: 外勤人员基本都用 Telegram 沟通，所以想要一个带内联按钮的机器人处理交接班；网站搜索在圣保罗和新加坡都要瞬时响应，但我们不想自己运维服务器；员工登录已经在 Okta 里配了 SAML 应用和按组授权，这些必须照旧。

holdout.en: The whole installation runs in a bunker with no internet access, so search has to be a single binary we drop on a box and feed our documentation into, file storage must be an S3-compatible server we host ourselves, and the community around the project gathers in Discord where we want slash commands and moderation buttons.
holdout.zh: 整套系统部署在没有外网的环境里，搜索得是能直接丢到机器上、把文档灌进去的单文件服务，文件存储也必须是自建的、兼容 S3 的服务器；项目社区都在 Discord 上，希望有斜杠命令和审核按钮。

holdout.en: Our help content is chat-first: conversations and customer profiles sit in Intercom, and the help centre has to filter and facet results with very low latency on a couple of cheap boxes; we also embed short walkthrough clips and want signed playback tokens so links cannot be forwarded outside the account, with delivery through the CDN we already pay for.
holdout.zh: 我们的帮助内容以聊天为主：会话和客户资料都在 Intercom 里，帮助中心要在两台便宜的机器上做到极低延迟的筛选和分面；我们还嵌了一些操作演示短片，希望播放令牌带签名，链接不能被转发到账号以外，分发就走已经在付费的 CDN。

holdout.en: When a producer drops a master file into our bucket we want broadcast-grade renditions with automatic quality checks, using the IAM role already provisioned; the pipeline lives in GitHub and should obtain cloud credentials without long-lived keys, cache dependencies and publish artefacts per commit.
holdout.zh: 制作人把母版文件传进我们的存储桶后，希望自动生成广播级的多档成品并做质量检查，用已经建好的 IAM 角色就行；流水线放在 GitHub 上，要能不靠长期密钥取得云权限，还要缓存依赖并按提交产出构建物。

holdout.en: We would rather not think about encoding ladders at all, so uploads should go somewhere that returns playback IDs and thumbnails; the internal library pages must keep the Kibana dashboards and query syntax we have relied on for years, and the checkout journey needs to be exercised in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with traces whenever it breaks.
holdout.zh: 我们完全不想操心码率阶梯，上传后交给服务方处理，拿回播放 ID 和缩略图就好；内部片库页面要继续用我们依赖多年的 Kibana 仪表盘和查询语法；结算流程得在 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 里都跑一遍，出错时留下追踪记录。

holdout.en: Our vans record continuously and the clips contain customers' faces and licence plates, so nothing may leave our own hardware; we need local transcoding with watch folders and loudness levelling, trip records in MySQL with consistent snapshots and point-in-time recovery, and route matching from a provider with strong automotive and logistics coverage for the daily logs.
holdout.zh: 我们的货车一直在录像，画面里有顾客的脸和车牌，素材绝不能离开自己的机器；需要本地转码、监控目录和响度统一，行程记录存在 MySQL 里要做一致性快照并支持按时间点恢复，每日日志的路线匹配则要用在汽车和物流领域覆盖扎实的服务商。

holdout.en: We train on eight GPUs with plain PyTorch loops and do not want to restructure the code, just launch one process per card and sync gradients; the images we ship must be scanned layer by layer with the build failing on critical findings, all wired into CircleCI with layer reuse so feedback stays quick.
holdout.zh: 我们用八张卡训练，代码就是普通的 PyTorch 循环，不想大改，只想每张卡起一个进程同步梯度；要发布的镜像得逐层扫描，出现严重漏洞就让构建失败，这些接进 CircleCI，并靠层复用让反馈快一些。

holdout.en: Spanish clients need Facturae XML plus periodic SII reporting with IVA and recargo de equivalencia handled properly; our stack is small and we like keeping compose files, updating services with one command on a Swarm cluster; Redis holds session and rate-limit data that must survive restarts with TTLs intact, and a bot inside Teams should answer common questions with adaptive cards for the whole tenant.
holdout.zh: 西班牙客户需要 Facturae 格式的 XML，还要定期做 SII 申报，IVA 和附加等价税都得算对；我们规模不大，喜欢继续用 compose 文件，在 Swarm 集群上一条命令更新服务；Redis 里存着会话和限流数据，重启后要连 TTL 一起恢复；还想要一个装在 Teams 里的机器人，用自适应卡片给整个租户回答常见问题。

holdout.en: French public buyers want hybrid PDFs that are both readable and machine-parsable, submitted through Chorus Pro, and we have to stay ahead of the reform deadlines; builds run in our own GitLab with protected variables per environment, translations are managed on a self-hosted platform so the language data stays under our control, and month-end figures go to auditors as a multi-sheet workbook with frozen headers and formulas.
holdout.zh: 法国公共部门买家要的是既能人读又能被系统解析的混合 PDF，并通过 Chorus Pro 提交，还得赶在改革时间节点之前；构建跑在自己的 GitLab 上，按环境使用受保护的变量；翻译放在自托管平台上，语言数据要掌握在自己手里；月末数字则要交给审计方一份多工作表、带冻结表头和公式的工作簿。

holdout.en: We already run Consul and Vault, so jobs should be scheduled through Nomad and pick up secrets from Vault rather than sitting in manifests; the customer portal authenticates against a realm we host ourselves with federated social logins, and after a contractor committed a private key we need something that reads the full history for tokens and tells us what to rotate; delivery estimates rely on custom map styling and directions.
holdout.zh: 我们已经在用 Consul 和 Vault，所以任务希望由 Nomad 调度，密钥直接从 Vault 取而不是写进清单；客户门户的认证走我们自己托管的域，并支持联合登录；之前有外包把私钥提交进了仓库，需要能翻遍完整历史找出令牌并提示该换哪些；配送时间估算则依赖可自定义样式的地图和路线服务。

holdout.en: Our services already run on the cluster with existing manifests and a couple of custom controllers, so scheduling and rollback should keep working there; pull requests must be blocked when the scanner finds injection or unsafe deserialisation with line-level suggestions; incidents need to link back to engineering issues in Jira Service Management, and the front-end suite has to run in a real browser with network stubbing so writing tests stays pleasant.
holdout.zh: 我们的服务已经跑在集群里，有现成的清单和几个自定义控制器，调度和回滚得继续在那儿工作；扫描器一旦发现注入或不安全反序列化，就要给出具体到行的修改建议并卡住合并请求；故障单要能关联到 Jira Service Management 里的研发问题；前端测试得在真实浏览器里跑，还能模拟网络请求，写起来才不痛苦。

holdout.en: Search over experiment notes has to keep the Kibana dashboards and query syntax the researchers already rely on; hyperparameter sweeps should start on a laptop and then run the same Python on a cluster; datasets sit in Cloud Storage with uniform access and we query them from BigQuery, and the weekly readout is published as a refreshed report in a Power BI workspace with row-level security per client.
holdout.zh: 实验记录的检索要继续沿用研究人员习惯的 Kibana 仪表盘和查询语法；超参数扫描要能在笔记本上跑起来，之后同一份 Python 直接扩到集群；数据集放在 Cloud Storage 上使用统一权限，并通过 BigQuery 查询；每周汇总则发布到 Power BI 工作区，按客户做行级权限并定时刷新。

holdout.en: Players hang out on Discord, so support there needs slash commands, buttons and moderation hooks; player emails should land in Freshdesk with our groups and automation rules mapped over; the account and purchase flows must be exercised in three browser engines in CI; and the game text is translated on a platform where translators see screenshots and automated QA runs before anything merges.
holdout.zh: 玩家都在 Discord 上，那边的客服需要斜杠命令、按钮和审核钩子；玩家邮件要进 Freshdesk，并按我们现有的分组和自动化规则分流；账号和购买流程要在持续集成里用三种浏览器内核各跑一遍；游戏文案则在一个能让译者看到截图、合并前自动做质量检查的平台上翻译。

holdout.en: Our lab has both TensorFlow and PyTorch code, so distributed training has to work across frameworks with ring allreduce; dependency advisories should be matched from lockfiles and SBOMs with safe upgrade paths proposed; pipelines run on our own agents with dynamic steps and fine-grained concurrency; model artefacts and datasets live in Blob Storage with SAS tokens and a hot-to-archive policy.
holdout.zh: 实验室里既有 TensorFlow 也有 PyTorch 代码，分布式训练要跨框架可用，采用环形全归约；依赖告警要从锁文件和 SBOM 里比对出来，并给出安全的升级路径；流水线跑在自己的 agent 上，需要动态步骤和细粒度并发控制；模型和数据集放在 Blob 存储里，用 SAS 令牌访问并按热度分层归档。

holdout.en: The model no longer fits on one device, so optimizer state and parameters must be sharded with CPU offload and mixed precision configured for us; the product catalogue lives in MongoDB and has to be restored consistently with its indexes; a spreadsheet in a shared drive should refresh from the numbers several times a day with comment access; and admin-console sign-in should keep our existing user IDs and the social connections we already configured.
holdout.zh: 模型已经放不进单卡，优化器状态和参数要分片并支持卸载到 CPU，混合精度也帮我们配好；商品库在 MongoDB 里，恢复时要连索引一起保持一致；共享盘里的表格要每天多次用最新数字刷新，并允许评论；管理后台的登录要沿用现有用户 ID，同时保留我们已经配好的社交登录。

holdout.en: Estate agents upload walkthrough videos that we would rather not encode ourselves, so we just want playback IDs and thumbnails back; listing addresses are messy and should be matched against OpenStreetMap data we host to avoid licence fees; the listing copy is translated with branching and review steps; and because some buyers still use old browsers, the search pages must be checked across specific legacy versions and operating systems.
holdout.zh: 房产中介上传的看房视频我们不想自己编码，只要拿回播放 ID 和缩略图；房源地址很乱，希望用我们自己部署的 OpenStreetMap 数据来匹配，省掉许可费；房源文案的翻译要有分支和审校流程；另外有些买家还在用老浏览器，搜索页必须在指定的旧版本和操作系统组合上验证。

holdout.en: Our Mexican storefront must issue stamped CFDI invoices with RFC validation and correct IVA and IEPS; code review needs static analysis that flags risky patterns with line-level fixes; delivery addresses are entered badly and need rooftop accuracy with place IDs; and the invoice archive goes to Azure containers with time-limited SAS links and an archive tier after a year.
holdout.zh: 我们在墨西哥的网店要开具盖章的 CFDI 发票，校验 RFC，并正确计算 IVA 和 IEPS；代码审查环节需要静态分析，指出风险写法并给出行级修改建议；收货地址录入得很乱，需要能精确到屋顶并返回地点 ID 的解析；发票归档则放到 Azure 容器里，用限时 SAS 链接访问，一年后转入归档层。

holdout.en: Customer conversations from email and chat should all land in Zendesk with our macros and SLA policies preserved; the operational database is MySQL and needs encrypted dumps with a binary-log recovery drill; the quarterly service review goes out as a paginated PDF with a cover and charts that needs no further editing; and help-centre articles are translated through a community proofreading workflow synced to the repository.
holdout.zh: 来自邮件和聊天的客户对话都要进 Zendesk，并保留我们的宏和 SLA 策略；业务数据库是 MySQL，需要加密备份，并借助二进制日志做恢复演练；季度服务回顾要输出成带封面和图表的 PDF，可以直接打印或转发；帮助中心文章则通过社区校对流程翻译，并与代码仓库同步。

holdout.en: Invoices to German public bodies need the national XML with their routing identifier and correct tax treatment; workloads should be scheduled through Nomad since Vault already holds our secrets; the product catalogue needs typo tolerance and instant results from a single binary; a Slack bot should answer order questions in threads and respect workspace permissions; and the billing database needs WAL archiving for point-in-time recovery with verification restores.
holdout.zh: 开给德国公共机构的发票要用本国 XML 格式，带上对方给的流转编码并正确计税；任务希望交给 Nomad 调度，因为密钥已经在 Vault 里；商品目录需要容错拼写、即时返回的单文件搜索服务；Slack 机器人要在消息串里回答订单问题并遵守工作区权限；账务数据库则要用 WAL 归档做到按时间点恢复，并定期演练还原。

holdout.en: Italian invoices must be routed through the exchange in FatturaPA with split payment for public buyers; pipelines stay in our GitLab with merge-request rules and per-environment variables; staff authentication is centralised in Okta with SAML apps and lifecycle hooks; an old token turned up in a config file and we need history-wide detection plus rotation advice; and auditors want a plain delimited file with the raw ledger rows.
holdout.zh: 意大利的发票要以 FatturaPA 经交换系统提交，面向公共买家时还要处理拆分付款；流水线留在我们自己的 GitLab 里，按合并请求规则和不同环境变量执行；员工认证集中在 Okta，用 SAML 应用和生命周期钩子管理；配置文件里发现过旧令牌，需要能查遍历史并提示轮换；审计方则要一份原始流水的纯分隔文本文件。

holdout.en: Our rendering jobs should run as Fargate tasks under the AWS account and IAM roles we already manage, with outputs written to Cloudflare's S3-compatible store so egress does not bankrupt us; encoding should use broadcast-grade profiles with automatic quality checks; customer addresses need rooftop precision including place IDs when we schedule pickups; and the whole flow is wired into CircleCI with orbs and Docker layer reuse.
holdout.zh: 渲染任务希望以 Fargate 形式跑在我们已有的 AWS 账号和 IAM 角色下，成品写到 Cloudflare 那套兼容 S3 的存储里，免得流量费失控；编码要用广播级参数并自动做质量检查；安排上门取件时地址要精确到屋顶，最好还能返回地点 ID；整条流程接进 CircleCI，用 orb 和 Docker 层复用加速。

holdout.en: Product search should be hosted so shoppers on three continents get the same latency, and we want the built-in analytics instead of running our own cluster; recommendation models are tuned by sweeping parameters with the same Python from a laptop up to a cluster; merchandisers want a workbook with several sheets, frozen headers and charts; checkout must be verified on the exact old browser versions our enterprise buyers still use; and UI strings are translated in Crowdin with translation memory and community proofreading.
holdout.zh: 商品搜索希望用托管服务，让三大洲的顾客延迟一致，分析数据也用它自带的，不想自己维护集群；推荐模型通过扫参数调优，同一份 Python 从笔记本一直用到集群；运营人员想要一个多工作表、带冻结表头和图表的工作簿；结算流程要在企业买家用到的那些旧浏览器版本上逐一验证；界面文案则在 Crowdin 里借助翻译记忆和社区校对完成。

holdout.en: Requests that arrive through the Intercom messenger should appear in our queue with routing rules and response-time targets; a Teams app with adaptive cards and single sign-on through Entra should let people check status without leaving the chat; authentication for the customer app can stay in user pools inside our AWS account; before each release we want the staging URL crawled for injection and broken access control without needing source access; and Mongo needs index-preserving backups from a replica set.
holdout.zh: 从 Intercom  Messenger 进来的请求要按路由规则进入队列，并跟踪响应时限；装在 Teams 里的应用用自适应卡片、通过 Entra 单点登录，让人不用离开聊天就能查进度；客户应用的登录继续放在我们自己 AWS 账号下的用户池里；每次发布前，希望对预发布地址做爬取式探测，找出注入和越权问题而不必接触源码；Mongo 则要在副本集上做保留索引的备份。

holdout.en: Inspectors record video on their phones and it must be processed on our own machines because it shows people's homes, so we need watch folders and loudness normalisation locally; site addresses are resolved and routed with custom map styles; inspectors get progress updates through a Telegram bot with inline keyboards; each visit is tracked as a Jira Service Management request linked to the engineering backlog; and originals are archived in a bucket with lifecycle rules and presigned links.
holdout.zh: 检查员用手机拍视频，画面里有住户家里，所以必须在我们自己的机器上处理，需要本地监控目录和响度统一；工地地址用可自定义样式的地图做解析和路线规划；检查员通过带内联键盘的 Telegram 机器人收到进度提醒；每次上门都记成 Jira Service Management 工单并关联研发待办；原始文件则归档到存储桶，配合生命周期规则和预签名链接。

holdout.en: Training runs on a rack of eight GPUs with a standard PyTorch loop, so one process per card with gradient sync is enough; the inference services are small and we like keeping compose files, updating them with a single command on a Swarm cluster; builds run on GitHub with matrix jobs, caching and short-lived cloud credentials; the admin UI is tested in a real browser with network stubbing; and translations are handled on a platform with screenshots and automated QA.
holdout.zh: 训练跑在八卡的机架上，就是普通 PyTorch 循环，每卡一个进程同步梯度就够；推理服务很小，我们喜欢继续用 compose 文件，在 Swarm 集群上一条命令更新；构建放在 GitHub 上，用矩阵任务、缓存和短期云凭证；管理界面的测试在真实浏览器里跑并模拟网络请求；翻译则放在带截图和自动质量检查的平台上。

holdout.en: Invoices to French public bodies go through Chorus Pro as hybrid PDFs and we must keep up with the reform timetable; customer login should move to our identity tenant without changing user IDs, carrying over the login rules we wrote; delivery complaints arrive by email and social and must be routed with service targets in Freshdesk; fleet routing needs a provider strong in automotive and logistics; and the monthly operations review is printed as a paginated PDF with a cover and charts.
holdout.zh: 开给法国公共机构的发票以混合 PDF 通过 Chorus Pro 提交，还要跟上改革时间表；客户登录要迁到我们的身份租户里，但用户 ID 不能变，之前写的登录规则也要带过去；配送投诉来自邮件和社交平台，要在 Freshdesk 里按服务时限分流处理；车队路线需要一家在汽车和物流领域覆盖强的服务商；每月运营回顾则打印成带封面和图表的 PDF。

holdout.en: The catalogue search must do low-latency faceting on modest hardware and stay entirely on-premises; dependency advisories should be matched from lockfiles and SBOMs with safe upgrade paths; Redis holds carts and rate-limit counters and must be snapshotted with TTLs preserved to remote storage; files live on a self-hosted S3-compatible server because the site is air-gapped; and a headless Chrome job should render invoices to PDF as part of the smoke checks.
holdout.zh: 目录搜索要在普通硬件上做低延迟分面，并且完全部署在本地；依赖告警要从锁文件和 SBOM 比对出来，并给出安全的升级路径；Redis 存着购物车和限流计数，需要连 TTL 一起快照到远端存储；文件放在自建的、兼容 S3 的服务器上，因为站点是隔离网络的；另外要用无头 Chrome 在冒烟检查里把发票渲染成 PDF。

holdout.en: Viewers should get embeddable players with signed tokens from the CDN we already use; the ranking model is too big for one card, so parameters and optimizer state must be sharded with CPU offload; builds have to run on our own controllers because the environment is regulated; subtitles and UI copy are translated with branching and machine-translation post-editing; and the weekly content report is shared as a formatted spreadsheet in a shared drive that refreshes itself.
holdout.zh: 观众应该拿到可嵌入的播放器，令牌带签名，分发走我们已经在用的 CDN；排序模型单卡放不下，参数和优化器状态要分片并支持卸载到 CPU；由于环境受监管，构建必须跑在自己的控制器上；字幕和界面文案的翻译要有分支流程和机器翻译后编辑；每周内容报告则以带格式的表格发到共享盘并自动刷新。
